diff.title: Changes · {file}
diff.binary: Binary file: the changes can't be shown.
diff.none: No changes in the content (only mode or name).

diff.untracked: New, untracked file: all of it is added.
diff.truncated: Changes too long: only the first part is shown.

mergeEditor.binary: Binary file: choose which version to keep.
mergeEditor.tooLarge: File too large for the editor: choose which version to keep.
mergeEditor.whole: The file was changed on one side and deleted (or created) on the other: choose which version to keep. {ours} is your branch, {theirs} the one being merged.
mergeEditor.resultHint: Follows your choices; you can also edit it by hand. Conflicts not chosen keep their markers.
